name: Masquerading
summary: Adversaries may use masquerading to disguise a malicious application or executable as another file, to avoid operator and engineer suspicion. Possible disguises of these masquerading files can include commonly found programs, expected vendor executables and configuration files, and other commonplace application and naming conventions. By impersonating expected and vendor-relevant files and applications, operators and engineers may not notice the…

analytics.name: Analytic 1858
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies a process or scheduled task whose displayed name matches a known Industrial Control System (ICS) vendor application but whose on-disk binary hash or file path does not match the vendor-signed baseline. The mismatch -- name says one thing, binary integrity says another -- is the defining signal. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when execution violates an approved signer/hash/path/parent/process or tool allowlist, or originates from an unauthorized user/tool, and is tied to an OT asset or follow-on OT-relevant action. Suppress vendor-signed software, approved engineering utilities, diagnostics, patching, backup, and documented maintenance.

analytics.name: Analytic 2123
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies a process whose executable name matches a known Industrial Control System (ICS) service daemon but whose execution path falls outside the documented vendor installation directories, or whose binary hash does not match the package manager's recorded checksum for that package. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when execution violates an approved signer/hash/path/parent/process or tool allowlist, or originates from an unauthorized user/tool, and is tied to an OT asset or follow-on OT-relevant action. Suppress vendor-signed software, approved engineering utilities, diagnostics, patching, backup, and documented maintenance.

analytics.name: Analytic 2231
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies an ICS device presenting protocol identity attributes (for example vendor, product, model, or capability identifiers) that conflict with the identity and capabilities recorded for that network address/device in the authorized asset inventory. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when execution violates an approved signer/hash/path/parent/process or tool allowlist, or originates from an unauthorized user/tool, and is tied to an OT asset or follow-on OT-relevant action. Suppress vendor-signed software, approved engineering utilities, diagnostics, patching, backup, and documented maintenance.

analytics.name: Analytic 2287
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies traffic on an Industrial Control System (ICS) protocol port (e.g., 502, 20000, 44818, etc.) with payload content that does not conform to the expected protocol structure for that port, suggesting non-ICS traffic tunneled over ICS port numbers to evade port-based filtering or blend with expected traffic patterns.
